# Vendored Slughorn core

This directory contains the minimal Slughorn core used by SlugVulkan.

- Upstream: https://github.com/AlphaPixel/slughorn.git
- Upstream base commit: b8fae8376a18d391422a98b2cdd9bffbb68a21f5
- SlugVulkan adaptation snapshot: cc7f3bf175bb20689b7e60512061edb3b5ae7ebe
- License: MIT; see LICENSE.

Only the source and headers required by SlugVulkan are vendored here. Upstream examples, tests,
Python bindings, CI files, optional adapters, and unrelated third-party trees are intentionally
excluded.
